observations.text: One real click on the count of recommended card 2 stayed on / (first click after the first 1280x800 emulation, no click listener attached, so it is unknown whether the event reached the page). Not reproduced: the same coordinates and flow navigated on all 3 later attempts, including one after repeating the resize sequence; hit-testing returned a.crate-link for that point. Overall 1 miss in 9 recommended-card clicks. Likely harness, but the cause was not established.

An awaited router.push in the hidden pane did not resolve within the 45s tool timeout, though navigation completed once a screenshot forced a frame. Consistent with the known view-transition stall in a hidden pane, and not treated as a defect.
On the owner's profile the 'Edit profile' button sits a few pixels right of the counts and name above it, and tight under the counts line, at both 1280 and 320.
Console errors were 401s only in the signed-out and page-load checks read during this run; a filter for Vue errors returned none. A full console audit is AC27 and was not in this re-test's scope.
